extracted.name: Boozy dark delight
extracted.description: Enjoy this night-cap cocktail to round off your evening. Made with stout, whisky and orange liqueur, it's smooth and rich – ideal for cooler evenings
instruction_lines: Drop a few ice cubes, if using, into a short glass and pour over the orange liqueur and whisky.
Top up the drink with the stout, then garnish with the chocolate orange shavings, if you like.
